cases.question: If a general-purpose AI model used more than 10^25 FLOPs for training, is it automatically and irrevocably a GPAI model with systemic risk without any further procedural possibility?
cases.tempting_wrong_answer: Yes. Crossing 10^25 FLOPs automatically settles the final legal classification.

source_candidates.identifier: European Commission GPAI AI Act Q&A

required_answer_elements: distinguish the Article 51(2) presumption from the Article 52 procedure

cases.question: For Airbus A380 ALS Part 1 Revision 14 referenced by EASA AD 2026-0154, is the Airbus document itself the legal source that makes compliance mandatory?
cases.tempting_wrong_answer: Yes. Airbus labels/controls the maintenance document, so the manufacturer's document itself creates the mandatory legal obligation.

source_candidates.locator: publication and related information / required actions
Do I have to comply with a mandatory Service Bulletin?

required_answer_elements: separate private technical content from the EASA mandate
state what changes when an AD covers a manufacturer document
avoid treating a manufacturer's 'mandatory' label alone as public legal authority

cases.question: Did Schrems II make all EU-to-US personal-data transfers based on Standard Contractual Clauses automatically unlawful on 16 July 2020?
cases.tempting_wrong_answer: Yes. The Court invalidated the EU-US transfer framework, so SCC-based transfers were automatically invalid too.
required_answer_elements: identify Decision 2010/87 on SCCs as surviving validity review
preserve the separate obligation to suspend/prohibit a transfer where required protection cannot in fact be ensured
avoid collapsing all transfer mechanisms into one legal state

cases.question: On 1 January 2025, were laptops already required by the EU common-charger rules to provide the harmonised USB-C charging solution?
cases.tempting_wrong_answer: Yes. The common-charger rules applied from 28 December 2024 to all listed device categories including laptops.
required_answer_elements: state 28 December 2024 for the non-laptop listed categories
do not invent extra machinery for a straightforward date/scope question

cases.question: What did the authentic Dutch publication of AI Act recital 19 say about online spaces before 19 December 2025, and may a current corrected/consolidated text be used by itself to answer that historical-source-state question?
cases.tempting_wrong_answer: The Dutch text has always said online spaces are outside scope because the current corrected text says so.

source_candidates.locator: Dutch consolidated text and version metadata

required_answer_elements: state the pre-corrigendum wording documented by the corrigendum
distinguish historical authentic source state from current corrected/consolidated representation
do not infer the historical wording from current text alone
